headline: Your phone can now grade itself: the CLAP TEST screen is live
lede: One chromeless page turns Jon's palm slaps into the ±50 ms audio-vs-frames proof the PLAICRAFT S1 acceptance line demands — same consent gate, same recorder, same grader the studio runs, verdict in big letters on the phone.

notes.text: jalfern.com/retrogames/claptest: START → consent (nothing checked by default) → slap the screen 3× about 2 s apart → PASS/FAIL with slaps heard, pairs and worst gap in ms, plus a plain hint when it fails. The take uploads through the usual outbox and sync badge.

Phone and studio now share ONE edge-extraction (clapSync.takeEdges): plaicraft:clap re-grades the uploaded bytes to identical numbers — the two surfaces cannot drift by construction, and a pinned gate proves it every run.

recordcheck 138/138 incl. the three acceptance mutants RED (taps +120 ms, taps with no sound, fewer than 3 slaps); the new claptestplay driver slaps the real screen with trusted pointer events against the production worker in Node — clean PASS worst 44.4 ms, all mutants red on both surfaces.

PLAICRAFT S1 (#1711) keeps its building label: the remaining lines are Jon's takes on the phone — the slap test is now one screen instead of a puzzling sequence — and #2157, which moves grading off Jon entirely.
